hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Two anagram strings are similar if they differ in at most two character positions.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Model strings as graph vertices and place edges between similar pairs.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Count connected components across the resulting equivalence graph.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Pairwise similarity checks joined with disjoint set union.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without disjoint set union component tracking becomes redundant and slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent array tracks component roots for n elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implements disjoint set union and counts distinct root components.
